# NixieClock partition table — 4MB flash: # Two ~1.875MB app slots (ota_0/ota_1) + otadata. The MQTT+web build uses
# ~1.0MB (~54% of a slot); a future NimBLE (Shelly BTHome) build fits at ~76%
# so both features stay OTA-updatable without another cabled flash. The web UI
# streams a new firmware.bin into the inactive slot and reboots into it.
# NVS and phy_init are kept BYTE-FOR-BYTE at their old offsets so the settings
# AND WiFi/MQTT credentials the firmware stores survive this repartition — no
# re-provisioning after the one-time serial flash that installs this table.
# App partitions must be 64KB-aligned; the 56KB gap between otadata (ends
# 0x12000) and ota_0 (0x20000) is that alignment padding.
# 'storage' is a small SPIFFS area (currently unused) reserved in case we ever
# serve web assets from a filesystem instead of embedding them in the binary.
